brief.text: System apocalypse. When the System arrives, every person on Earth receives exactly one Slot for one skill. The protagonist, a man in his twenties, receives a Slot that can hold as many skills as he can take. Invent the rest.

chapter: the exception is one person's and works on the page in chapter one
no debt, ledger, licence or administration register
system numbers are present and the status sheet renders
progression is felt in the chapter
the protagonist is in his twenties with a prior life the reader has lived
the chapter's attention goes to the pursuit, not to one procedure
the tone matches the popcorn shelf
concept: the exception belongs to one person and works for them in chapter one
the ranks are counted and system.start_rank places the protagonist on them
no debt, ledger, court or tenancy frame in the premise, the threat or the system's look
listing: the listing promises LitRPG: a system and progression the reader can see
the exception it sells is the one person's, not a shared or issued power
no institution-issued engine and no debt, ledger, court, tenancy or licence frame
no internal schema word in the title or the listing
world: no administrative pressure: the pressure comes from people, danger, distance and need
the protagonist is placed on the ladder at the concept's start rank, or not placed for an unranked start
world check reports no snapshot fault and no would-breach
